body:
The household absorbs an unconventional choice as if it had always been the plan.

Somebody rearranges a room for the project, everyone bends the schedule around the new commitment, and nobody performs surprise; the want just gets a place in daily life.

With the Moon trine Lilith, the people who run the daily container quietly give the banished appetite a shelf in it.

Because nobody has to fight for it, the change happens almost silently.

The ease may be real, but what a family absorbs without discussion also goes unexamined, and its needs keep growing.
